objective: Determine whether Scale has predictable deployable gain over each route's best constant; no SFT/DPO
hypothesis: A constant shrink may explain prior learned-Scale gains; heterogeneous human scales need not imply predictable content signal
constant_grid_basis: predeclared geometry sweep, augmented with the existing eight GNMC-train-only bins; not a learned action-bin refit
selection: deterministic SHA256 source split of Val into 50% tune and 50% internal confirmation; select on tune Macro only; no Train/Val source mixing
validation_exposure: historical Val is already exposed; internal confirmation is not a fresh final test
bootstrap_unit: independent video source for LIVE; independent image source for GNMC
oracle_prefix: global tune-ranked existing fixed actions; never per-frame GT top K
oracle_scope: exact fixed-action upper bound, not learned candidate generation or an estimate of achievable improvement
scale_insertion: after existing frozen final P1 QP; preserves original P1 frame set and deployed centers
visual_probe: label-blind GNMC RGB/spectral features; fixed ridge alpha=10; train-only standardization; 5 source folds; 100 train-label permutation controls; no SFT/DPO
center_jitter: diagnostic only: +/-0.01, +/-0.03, +/-0.05 of active image dimension; compare mutually legal actions
expected_result: unknown; report null for unmeasured deployment, subject or rater effects
risks: historical raw center cache lacks final P1 path
transposed LIVE B is not native B evidence
single crop annotation cannot identify rater noise
annotation scale may contain geometry/style effects
